evidence.quote: Northgate Builders Group
evidence.rationale: The preamble identifies Northgate Builders Group as "Contractor".

evidence.quote: Allied Fire Protection, Inc.
evidence.rationale: The preamble identifies Allied Fire Protection, Inc. as "Subcontractor".

evidence.quote: Coastal Logistics REIT
evidence.rationale: The recital names Coastal Logistics REIT as "Owner" under the Prime Contract.

evidence.quote: Port of Stockton Warehouse 7
evidence.rationale: The recital names the project as Port of Stockton Warehouse 7, 1850 Wharf Access Road, Stockton, CA.

evidence.quote: This Subcontract is governed by the laws of the State of California.
evidence.rationale: Paragraph 14.1 states California governing law.

evidence.quote: This is a pay-when-paid provision.
evidence.rationale: Paragraph 4.3 labels the clause pay-when-paid. Paragraph 4.4 states it is not a condition precedent shifting the risk of Owner nonpayment.

evidence.quote: Payment to Subcontractor becomes due within seven (7) days after Contractor's receipt of the corresponding payment from Owner.
evidence.rationale: Paragraph 4.3 states seven days after Contractor's receipt of Owner payment.

evidence.quote: Contractor and Subcontractor agree in writing, for purposes of California Business and Professions Code Section 7108.5, to the following payment terms
evidence.rationale: The parties expressly agree in writing to a specific seven-day period.

evidence.quote: Retention under this Subcontract is five percent (5%).
evidence.rationale: Rider A.2 sets retention at 5% and expressly supersedes the 10% in Paragraph 5.1. Rider A controls under Paragraphs 1.5 and A.1.

release_condition.value: (a) Final Completion of the Subcontract Work; and (b) Contractor's receipt of retention from Owner attributable to the Subcontract Work; also subject to Contractor's Article 7 rights and delivery of conditional final waiver

evidence.quote: (a) Final Completion of the Subcontract Work; and - (b) Contractor's receipt of retention from Owner attributable to the Subcontract Work.
evidence.rationale: Paragraph 5.2 states both conditions. Paragraph 5.3 adds Article 7 rights and the final waiver requirement. Rider A.2 keeps the Article 5 release terms in effect.

evidence.quote: ten (10) days after both
evidence.rationale: Paragraph 5.2 requires release within ten days after both conditions occur.

evidence.quote: Subcontractor must deliver a Conditional Waiver and Release on Progress Payment (Civil Code Section 8132) before Contractor releases any progress payment.
evidence.rationale: Paragraph 6.2 requires it. Paragraph 4.1 also requires it with each application.

evidence.quote: Subcontractor shall deliver an Unconditional Waiver and Release on Progress Payment (Civil Code Section 8134) for the amount received.
evidence.rationale: Paragraph 6.3 requires an unconditional waiver within five days after each progress payment.

evidence.quote: With each application for payment, Subcontractor shall furnish waivers and releases from each of its lower-tier subcontractors and material suppliers whose work or materials are included in the application.
evidence.rationale: Paragraph 6.4 requires lower-tier conditional and unconditional waivers.

evidence.quote: All waivers and releases required under this Subcontract shall be on the statutory forms set out in California Civil Code Sections 8132, 8134, 8136 and 8138, as applicable.
evidence.rationale: Paragraph 6.1 requires the statutory forms and rejects modified forms.

evidence.quote: Contractor may set off against any amount due to Subcontractor, under this Subcontract or any other agreement between the parties, the reasonable cost of the following, including a markup of ten percent (10%) for Contractor's supervision and administration
evidence.rationale: Paragraph 7.2 grants setoff rights for backcharges and other costs. Written notice is required under Paragraph 7.3.

evidence.quote: Contractor may withhold from any payment an amount sufficient to cover the cost to correct Subcontract Work that is defective or does not conform to the Subcontract Documents.
evidence.rationale: Paragraph 7.1 permits withholding for defective work. Paragraph 7.4 adds liens, lower-tier nonpayment and liquidated damages.

evidence.quote: Contractor will not pay for materials or equipment stored on or off the site.
evidence.rationale: Paragraph 4.2 expressly excludes payment for stored materials.

anomalies.description: Paragraph 5.1 states 10% retention, but Rider A.2 replaces it with 5%. Rider A controls under Paragraphs 1.5 and A.1. Billing systems set up from the body of the Subcontract would over-withhold.

evidence.quote: This rate supersedes and replaces the ten percent (10%) retention rate stated in Paragraph 5.1 of the Subcontract.
evidence.rationale: Paragraph 5.1 states 10% retention, but Rider A.2 replaces it with 5%. Rider A controls under Paragraphs 1.5 and A.1. Billing systems set up from the body of the Subcontract would over-withhold.

anomalies.description: Rider A has blank initial lines for Contractor and Subcontractor. Confirm the rider was executed before relying on the 5% rate.

evidence.quote: Acknowledged and agreed:
evidence.rationale: Rider A has blank initial lines for Contractor and Subcontractor. Confirm the rider was executed before relying on the 5% rate.

anomalies.description: Retention release depends on Contractor's receipt of retention from Owner, in addition to Final Completion. It is also subject to Contractor's Article 7 withholding rights.

evidence.quote: The release of retention is subject to Contractor's rights under Article 7.
evidence.rationale: Retention release depends on Contractor's receipt of retention from Owner, in addition to Final Completion. It is also subject to Contractor's Article 7 withholding rights.

anomalies.description: If Owner fails to pay, the fallback payment obligation is 'within a reasonable time', which has no fixed number of days.

evidence.quote: Contractor shall pay Subcontractor within a reasonable time for Subcontract Work properly performed.
evidence.rationale: If Owner fails to pay, the fallback payment obligation is 'within a reasonable time', which has no fixed number of days.

anomalies.description: Setoff extends to amounts due under any other agreement between the parties (cross-contract setoff). Setoff costs carry a 10% markup.

evidence.quote: Contractor may set off against any amount due to Subcontractor, under this Subcontract or any other agreement between the parties
evidence.rationale: Setoff extends to amounts due under any other agreement between the parties (cross-contract setoff). Setoff costs carry a 10% markup.

anomalies.description: Contractor may withhold for Owner-assessed liquidated damages, stop payment notices, liens and lower-tier nonpayment, in addition to defective work.

evidence.quote: liquidated damages assessed by Owner and attributable to Subcontractor's delay.
evidence.rationale: Contractor may withhold for Owner-assessed liquidated damages, stop payment notices, liens and lower-tier nonpayment, in addition to defective work.

anomalies.description: Contractor may hold the entire next progress payment until it receives the unconditional waiver for the prior payment.

evidence.quote: Contractor may withhold the next progress payment until it receives that unconditional waiver.
evidence.rationale: Contractor may hold the entire next progress payment until it receives the unconditional waiver for the prior payment.
